name: Young Dragon
summary: A dragon barely a century old, already as big as a house, greedy, proud, and quick to breathe fire.

name: Ancient Dragon
summary: A wyrm older than most nations, cunning and steeped in sorcery; its shadow alone sends armies running.

powers.name: Dread Presence
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (cowed)

powers.name: Keen Senses
powers.detail: Darkvision, Scent, Extended Vision, Detect Magic (ranged)

name: Giant Spider
summary: A spider the size of a pony that webs up alleys and tunnels and paralyzes its victims with venom.

linked.name: Venom
linked.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed

name: Gargoyle
summary: A winged creature of living stone that perches among cathedral spires and passes for a statue until it moves.

powers.name: Statue Stillness
powers.detail: Holds perfectly still to pass as a carved statue

name: Werewolf
summary: A cursed human who becomes a towering wolf-beast under the full moon; wounds close almost instantly unless made with silver.

powers.name: Keen Senses
powers.detail: Low-light Vision, Scent, Tracking, Acute Hearing

name: Minotaur
summary: A bull-headed giant of a man that guards its maze and never loses its way inside it.

name: Cyclops
summary: A one-eyed giant shepherd and smith who smashes with a tree-trunk club and hurls boulders.

name: Griffin
summary: Eagle in front and lion behind; a proud guardian of treasure that can be tamed as a flying mount.

name: Hydra
summary: A many-headed swamp serpent whose heads grow back as fast as heroes can cut them off.

name: Sea Serpent
summary: A ship-crushing serpent from the deep that coils around hulls and drags them under.

name: Yeti
summary: A shaggy white giant of the high mountains, seldom seen and almost impossible to track through snow.

name: Troll
summary: A warty, long-armed brute that heals almost any wound in moments. Only fire and acid keep it down.

name: Swamp Beast
summary: A hulking mound of moss, roots, and muck that rises from the bayou and smothers those who trespass.

powers.name: Smothering Muck
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered and Vulnerable, Defenseless and Immobile, Incapacitated

powers.name: Merge with Swamp
powers.detail: Sinks into swamp water and mud and re-forms elsewhere nearby

name: Wendigo
summary: A gaunt, antlered spirit of hunger that stalks the winter woods, mimicking the voices of its victims' loved ones.

powers.name: Haunting Mimicry
powers.detail: Imitates any voice it has heard

name: Chupacabra
summary: A spiny, leaping cryptid that drains livestock (and the occasional rancher) of blood in the night.

name: Stone Golem
summary: A towering statue animated by an old spell, following its last command with mindless persistence.

name: Zombie
summary: A shambling animated corpse, slow and mindless, dangerous mostly in large numbers.

name: Skeleton Warrior
summary: Animated bones in rusted armor, raised by a necromancer to guard a tomb or march as a legion.

name: Ghost
summary: The restless spirit of the dead, bound to a place or grudge. Its chilling touch drains the warmth from the living.

powers.name: Terrifying Visage
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (panic)

construct_note: Spirit construct: absent Strength and Stamina; Agility bought up from absent per DCA ch. 7.

name: Banshee
summary: A wailing spirit whose scream foretells death and can bring it on, shattering glass and stopping hearts.

powers.name: Deathly Wail
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated

construct_note: Spirit construct: absent Strength and Stamina; Agility bought up from absent per DCA ch. 7.

name: Vampire Spawn
summary: A newly risen vampire, ravenous and feral, still bound to the master who made it. Sunlight and stakes end it.

name: Mummy
summary: An embalmed priest-king risen to punish tomb robbers; its touch withers flesh and its gaze freezes the soul.

powers.name: Withering Touch
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Incapacitated

powers.name: Dread Gaze
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed

name: Lesser Demon
summary: A horned, bat-winged fiend from the infernal planes, summoned as a servant or loosed through a rift.

name: Greater Demon
summary: A demon lord's lieutenant: a winged colossus wreathed in hellfire, with the cunning to bargain for souls.

name: Hellhound
summary: A black, smoldering hound of the underworld that tracks the damned and breathes gouts of flame.

name: Alien Hunter Beast
summary: An off-world apex predator with chameleon skin and acid spit, bred or released to hunt sentient prey.

name: Alien Hive Drone
summary: An insectoid worker-soldier of an invading hive, acting as one with thousands of its siblings.

name: Winged Hellspawn Trooper
summary: A bat-winged shock trooper from a hellish alien world, attacking in screeching swarms with energized lances.

name: Giant Radioactive Ant
summary: A car-sized ant mutated by atomic testing, spraying acid and tunneling up beneath unsuspecting towns.

name: Killer Plant
summary: A carnivorous plant grown to monstrous size by alien spores or mad science, luring prey with sleep-inducing pollen.

powers.name: Sleep Pollen
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Asleep

name: Acidic Ooze
summary: A mindless, quivering blob of corrosive slime that slides under doors and dissolves whatever it engulfs.

powers.name: Engulf
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Incapacitated (suffocating)

name: Atomic Saurian
summary: A skyscraper-tall reptile woken by nuclear testing, wading ashore to flatten cities with its glowing atomic breath.

name: Abyssal Leviathan
summary: A tentacled horror from the ocean trench whose eerie song drives sailors mad before its arms pull down their ships.

powers.name: Maddening Song
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated
